levels.surface: عبد الرحمن بن عبد الله بن كعب

notes: «أن عبد الله بن كعب، قال سمعت كعبا» makes Abdullah a link (he heard Ka'b), and Ka'b, whose story it is, is the last link
«خالفهم معقل بن عبيد الله» names a different transmitter who disagrees: a variant group, not a route
the Prophet's words and Ka'b's narrative are the saying, with no further link
